pre_merge_control_head_rule: Pin the exact final durable control head immediately before merge creation. Its first-parent ancestry must contain eco_source_head_sha and its source delta may contain only this Work Order's allowed control records.
candidate_parent_rule: The candidate has exactly two parents: exact pre_merge_control_head_sha first and exact main_base_sha second. The candidate tree must equal the immediate first-parent tree.
freshness_rule: Any change to main_base_sha, eco_source_head_sha, passport blob, or source dry-merge tree before merge creation, synthetic PC0, evidence, exact-head review, draft PR, or human merge requires stop, immutable invalidation, refreshed manifest, and repeated review.
